t: The Viva Rigid Straight WC Pan Connector links a toilet pan spigot directly to a 110mm waste pipe. This straight pan connector is ideal for professional plumbers and DIYers completing bathroom refurbishments or toilet installations. Manufactured from durable white polypropylene, this rigid fitting ensures a reliable and secure leak-free seal. It features simple push-fit connections on both ends, with a 90 to 107mm inlet that accommodates standard toilet spigots and a 110mm outlet that connects quickly to existing soil pipes without needing specialist tools.
b: Suitable for all 4"/110mm PVC-U & Cast Iron Soil Pipe
